name: dog_rose
form_origin: The stems leave the ground together and the crown reaches the ground with them: there is no bole, so bole_frac is 0 and the envelope's t=0 sits at the foot. leaders is the stem count of an established stool; the grower divides the declared stem section among them by the pipe model, so this is one plant and not 6. The arching cane is what the weeping envelope and the NEGATIVE branch_up_bias together make: the cane leaves the base upward, runs out of stiffness and falls away. REQUIREMENTS III.7 calls this an arching cane form between shrub and climber; it is served here by the bush form and a hanging tropism, not by a form of its own.
dimensions_origin: [SET] from the mature open-grown band a European field guide gives the species; no measurement of an individual is claimed and every one is falsifiable against a photograph with a scale in it.
dbh_cm_origin: the diameter of ONE stem at 1.3 m; the grower solves its whole radius cascade against it and the pipe model gives the other stems the same section. 0 means the form carries no stem that reaches breast height and base_radius stands as declared.
lai_origin: [SET] one-sided leaf area per m2 of crown projection. A shrub layer measures below a closed forest canopy because it lives on what the canopy lets through; the band used here is 2...4 for an understorey woody and the value is placed within it by how dense the species' own foliage reads.
bark_origin: sRGB. Rose canes are green-brown and smooth between the prickles, which this grower does not shape.
